outcomes.question: For invoices belonging to jobs 1 through 12, RANK each invoice by amount descending within its job. Equal amounts must have the same rank. Order by JobId and InvoiceId. Return exactly these columns in this order: JobId, InvoiceId, Amount, InvoiceRank.

tool_calls.name: propose_query
tool_calls.arguments:
{"action":"query","sql":"WITH RankedInvoices AS (
    SELECT
        JobId,
        InvoiceId,
        Amount,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY JobId ORDER BY Amount DESC) AS InvoiceRank
    FROM reporting.vInvoices
    WHERE JobId BETWEEN 1 AND 12
)
SELECT JobId, InvoiceId, Amount, InvoiceRank
FROM RankedInvoices
ORDER BY JobId, InvoiceId","parameters":[],"clarification":""}

proposal.sql:
WITH RankedInvoices AS (
    SELECT
        JobId,
        InvoiceId,
        Amount,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY JobId ORDER BY Amount DESC) AS InvoiceRank
    FROM reporting.vInvoices
    WHERE JobId BETWEEN 1 AND 12
)
SELECT JobId, InvoiceId, Amount, InvoiceRank
FROM RankedInvoices
ORDER BY JobId, InvoiceId

outcomes.question: Show invoice-posting month number, total invoiced, previous month's total and month-over-month absolute change using LAG. First previous/change is NULL. Order by month number. Return exactly these columns in this order: InvoiceMonth, TotalInvoiced, PreviousTotal, Change.

tool_calls.name: propose_query
tool_calls.arguments:
{"action":"query","sql":"WITH MonthlyInvoicing AS (
    SELECT
        MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceMonth,
        SUM(Amount) AS TotalInvoiced
    FROM reporting.vInvoices
    GROUP BY MONTH(InvoiceDate)
)
SELECT
    InvoiceMonth,
    TotalInvoiced,
    LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth) AS PreviousTotal,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE TotalInvoiced - LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth)
    END AS Change
FROM MonthlyInvoicing
ORDER BY InvoiceMonth;","parameters":[],"clarification":""}

proposal.sql:
WITH MonthlyInvoicing AS (
    SELECT
        MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceMonth,
        SUM(Amount) AS TotalInvoiced
    FROM reporting.vInvoices
    GROUP BY MONTH(InvoiceDate)
)
SELECT
    InvoiceMonth,
    TotalInvoiced,
    LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth) AS PreviousTotal,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE TotalInvoiced - LAG(TotalInvoiced) OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceMonth)
    END AS Change
FROM MonthlyInvoicing
ORDER BY InvoiceMonth;

outcomes.validated_sql:
WITH [monthlyinvoicing] AS (
  SELECT
    MONTH([vinvoices].[invoicedate]) AS [invoicemonth],
    SUM([vinvoices].[amount]) AS [totalinvoiced]
  FROM [reporting].[vinvoices] AS [vinvoices]
  GROUP BY
    MONTH([vinvoices].[invoicedate])
)
SELECT
  [monthlyinvoicing].[invoicemonth] AS [invoicemonth],
  [monthlyinvoicing].[totalinvoiced] AS [totalinvoiced],
  LAG([monthlyinvoicing].[totalinvoiced]) OVER (ORDER BY [monthlyinvoicing].[invoicemonth]) AS [previoustotal],
  CASE
    WHEN LAG([monthlyinvoicing].[totalinvoiced]) OVER (ORDER BY [monthlyinvoicing].[invoicemonth]) IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    ELSE [monthlyinvoicing].[totalinvoiced] - LAG([monthlyinvoicing].[totalinvoiced]) OVER (ORDER BY [monthlyinvoicing].[invoicemonth])
  END AS [change]
FROM [monthlyinvoicing] AS [monthlyinvoicing]
ORDER BY
  [invoicemonth]
outcomes.explanation: The query returned 12 rows with invoicemonth, totalinvoiced, previoustotal, change. The complete bounded result is shown below; financial amounts use CAD.
